All chieftainships throughout the North-West Coast Agency are hereditary and the heir to a chieftainship is considered
a chief from his birth, but he requires to make a potlach before succeeding to the powers of a chieftain. Second
chieftainships are more family headships than tribal Chiefs.

[(t)Many chiefs as well as others have dropped their Indian names and hold only the names of white people given them
by missionaries.] 14 - 33 1/2
